problem: The resolution registry captured lessons but could not say what KIND of thing a lesson was, where it should surface, or what still had to happen before it could be trusted. Nine agency rules had been recorded as a flat list with no parent, the same rule had been recorded twice under two ids, and there was nowhere at all to put an idea that was not yet a rule. The operator: "What began as a Resolution Record is really becoming a Constitutional Knowledge Lifecycle for the platform… Not every insight is an invariant, and not every invariant belongs immediately in the canon."
observedFailure: CI-2026-08-03-EXCEPTION-TERMINATES-IN-ACT-001 and CI-2026-08-03-EXCEPTION-TERMINATES-IN-ACT-001 stated the same rule under two ids; the second carried no canary. Two records for one rule is the exact inv.engineering.036 defect the registry exists to prevent, occurring inside the registry itself.
Every candidate was unclassified: nothing recorded whether a rule protected software, governance, or the operator's ability to act.
Parent/child relations existed only as prose in `notes`, where nothing could read them — so a corollary could drift from its parent, or be mis-parented across families, with no error.
Nothing declared where a lesson should surface. "Projection" was an intention with no field to carry it.
Unresolved ideas had no home, so they either became premature candidate invariants or were lost.
rootCauses: The registry modelled the CAPTURE of a lesson but not its LIFECYCLE — there was one ladder for maturity and no axis at all for kind, destination, or readiness-to-apply.
A relation held as prose is not a relation. Anything a canary cannot read will eventually drift.
With no Exploration Workspace, the only way to record an idea was to assert it as a rule — which is precisely the "not every insight is an invariant" collapse.
resolution: Three families as a FACET of the existing record — engineering / constitutional / agency. Same registry, same COMPLETION_LIFECYCLE, no second store and no second ladder.
Formalised `parentCandidateId`, moving the parent/child relation out of prose into data, with referential integrity, cycle refusal, and a rule that a child shares its parent's family.
Restructured the nine agency rules under Agency Invariant I as six corollaries plus four second-level children — every one an EXISTING record re-parented, zero twins minted.
Merged the duplicated exception rule into the record that carried the canaries, folding in the twin's occurrence and recording the retired id.
Added `projections` to every record: targets, researchRequired, ratificationRequired, track. Declaring where something surfaces creates a pointer, never a copy.
Added the Exploration Workspace for unresolved ideas, with its own disposition vocabulary and no place on the invariant ladder.
Recorded the operator-ratified TTV/TTR objective, pointing at the platform's EXISTING PoTS / Net Value Acceleration definition rather than restating it.
Made the eight-question close-out checklist a real constant with a predefined destination per kind, so no agent invents a folder at close-out time.
rejectedApproaches: A second status vocabulary for resolution records (`superseded` / `withdrawn`). COMPLETION_LIFECYCLE already carries `deprecated`, and minting a rival ladder is what the loop exists to prevent. Reported to the operator rather than resolved silently.

A new store for Candidate Principles. `types/researchRegistry.ts` + `services/research/registryStore.ts` (CFS-051) already provide `research_candidate_principles` / `_invariants` / `_backlog_items`, live behind an API route and a codex tab. Structural-track work PROJECTS onto that register via the `research-registry` target instead.

A fresh definition of Proof of Time Saved. PoTS is already defined in the ratified Polity Papers commentary and computed in shipped code; a second definition would be the money-critical class of duplicate.

Building the Constitutional Computing Commons as a live knowledge graph. The operator describes it as a direction, not a deliverable; half-building a graph store is exactly the speculative work the loop exists to prevent. Recorded as an exploration item with what it would require.

Rewriting each agency rule's `statement` to the operator's corollary text. The statements are what the canaries and occurrences were recorded against; rewriting them would silently change the rules. The corollary text is carried verbatim in `classification`, which is what that field is for.
